Beginner Guide: 10 Things to Do First After Landing
刚落地海拉鲁不知道先干什么？按这 10 条走，前期基本不会走弯路。
Just landed in Hyrule and don't know what to do first? Follow these 10 steps and you will barely go wrong in the early game.

刚落地海拉鲁，自由度大到不知道先干什么？这篇把开荒前期的关键事项排成 10 条，按这个顺序走，前期基本不会走弯路。每一件都是老玩家开新档也会先做的事。

Just landed in Hyrule, the freedom is so great you don't know what to do first? This guide lines up the key early-game tasks into 10 steps — follow them in this order and you will barely go wrong early on. Every one of these is something veteran players do first even on a new save.
1. 初始空岛：拿齐四种能力再下岛
1. Great Sky Island: Get All Four Abilities Before Leaving the Island
初始空岛的 4 座神庙是强制教程，分别给究极手、余料建造、通天术、倒转乾坤。拿齐之后才能拿到滑翔伞离开空岛，别想着跳岛逃课，老老实实走完，这是全游戏的操作基础。

The 4 Shrines on the Great Sky Island are a mandatory tutorial, granting Ultrahand, Fuse, Ascend, and Recall respectively. Only after getting them all can you receive the Paraglider and leave the island — don't try to skip ahead by jumping off the island, just complete them properly, as they are the control foundation for the whole game.
2. 先开鸟望台，再跑图
2. Activate Skyview Towers First, Then Explore
全图 15 座鸟望台，点亮一座就解锁一片区域的地图，还能当传送点和高空跳板。开荒期每到一个新区域，第一件事就是找鸟望台弹射上天开图，盲跑最浪费时间。

There are 15 Skyview Towers across the map; lighting one unlocks the map for a region, and it also serves as a fast-travel point and a high-altitude launch pad. In the early game, the first thing to do whenever you reach a new region is to find its Skyview Tower, launch into the sky, and reveal the map — running blind wastes the most time.
3. 见神庙就进，祝福之光攒起来
3. Enter Every Shrine You See and Save Up Lights of Blessing
神庙给祝福之光，攒够了去女神像换红心或精力。前期优先把精力抬一抬，爬山、滑翔、游泳全靠它。神庙本身也是练四种能力的最好场所。

Shrines give Lights of Blessing; save up enough and trade them at a Goddess Statue for Heart Containers or Stamina Vessels. Early on, prioritize raising your stamina — climbing, gliding, and swimming all depend on it. Shrines themselves are also the best place to practice the four abilities.
4. 料理随手做，别只吃生食材
4. Cook as You Go — Don't Just Eat Raw Ingredients
食材直接吃回得少，放锅里煮效果好得多。赶路时顺手采蘑菇、肉、鱼，找个锅做几份恢复料理再走。靠近火堆简单烤一下也能应急，但效果不如锅里煮。

Eating ingredients raw restores little; cooking them in a pot works far better. While travelling, pick up mushrooms, meat, and fish along the way, find a pot, and cook a few recovery dishes before moving on. A quick roast by a campfire can work in an emergency, but it is not as effective as cooking in a pot.
5. 武器会坏是正常的，余料建造才是伤害来源
5. Weapons Breaking Is Normal — Fuse Is the Real Source of Damage
新手最容易心疼武器：其实武器本身面板只是基础，余料建造融上去的素材才是伤害大头。怪物素材、矿石、龙素材融上去，同一把武器伤害能翻几倍。武器坏了就换，别舍不得用。

New players most often hate to see weapons break: in fact, a weapon's own base stats are just the baseline, and the materials fused onto it with Fuse are the main source of damage. Fuse monster parts, ores, or dragon parts onto it and the same weapon can deal several times more damage. When a weapon breaks, replace it — don't be reluctant to use it.
6. 抓匹马，去驿站登记
6. Catch a Horse and Register It at a Stable
前期跑图全靠腿很慢，野外抓匹马去驿站登记，之后随时能叫马。马匹还能帮你驮东西、快速赶路，是前期性价比最高的代步工具。

Travelling on foot early on is very slow; catch a wild horse and register it at a Stable, and you can call your horse any time afterwards. Horses can also carry things for you and get you around quickly, making them the best-value transport in the early game.
7. 地底别急着去，先备好光和恢复
7. Don't Rush into the Depths — Prepare Light and Recovery First
地底一片漆黑，还有瘴气会扣你的红心上限。第一次下地底前，先带够光亮花种子和恢复料理，沿着光明根一盏一盏点亮，别在黑暗里瞎闯。

The Depths are pitch black, and Gloom will reduce your maximum hearts. Before your first trip down, bring enough Brightbloom Seeds and recovery dishes, and light the Lightroots one by one as you go — don't blunder around in the dark.
8. 呀哈哈顺手拿，背包扩充靠它
8. Grab Koroks as You Go — Bag Expansions Depend on Them
呀哈哈种子交给伯库林可以扩充武器袋、弓袋、盾袋
Give Korok Seeds to Hestu to expand your weapon, bow, and shield pouches
前期背包一满就难受，路上看到可疑的石头、石阵、花朵就顺手解一下，积少成多
A full bag early on is miserable, so solve any suspicious rocks, rock patterns, or flowers you pass on the road — they add up over time
详见本站呀哈哈种子全指南
See this site's Complete Korok Seed Guide for details
9. 主线顺序建议：风→水→火→雷
9. Suggested Main Quest Order: Wind → Water → Fire → Lightning
主线四个区域没有强制顺序，但按本站主线页的推荐，先利特村（风）、再卓拉领地（水）、鼓隆城（火）、格鲁德（雷），难度曲线最平滑。当然你也可以按自己的喜好走，自由度是这个游戏最大的优点。

The four main quest regions have no forced order, but following this site's main quest page recommendation — Rito Village (Wind) first, then Zora's Domain (Water), Goron City (Fire), and Gerudo (Lightning) — gives the smoothest difficulty curve. Of course, you can also go by your own preference; freedom is this game's greatest strength.
10. 别错过龙之泪和大师剑前置
10. Don't Miss the Dragon's Tears and the Master Sword Prerequisites
龙之泪回忆是理解主线剧情的关键，顺路看到地上图画就去看
The Dragon's Tears memories are key to understanding the main story, so check out any ground drawings you pass along the way
想拔大师剑需要整整两圈精力，平时多攒祝福之光换精力，拔剑方法详见本站白龙寻踪与大师之剑攻略

Drawing the Master Sword requires a full two wheels of stamina, so save up Lights of Blessing and trade them for stamina in your daily play; for how to draw the sword, see this site's Tracking the Light Dragon and the Master Sword guide
新手最常见的三个坑
The Three Most Common Beginner Pitfalls
黄精力拔不了剑：吃料理获得的黄色额外精力在拔剑时无效，必须是实打实的两圈精力。
Yellow stamina can't draw the sword: the yellow bonus stamina gained from eating dishes does not count when drawing the sword — you must have a genuine two full wheels of stamina.
黄精力拔不了剑：吃料理获得的黄色额外精力在拔剑时无效，必须是实打实的两圈精力
Yellow stamina can't draw the sword: the yellow bonus stamina gained from eating dishes does not count when drawing the sword — you must have a genuine two full wheels of stamina
雨天别爬山：下雨时岩壁湿滑，爬一半会滑下来，浪费精力。雨天改走平路或等雨停。
Don't climb in the rain: when it rains, rock walls are slippery and you will slide down halfway, wasting stamina. In rainy weather, take flat roads instead or wait for the rain to stop.
